description:
An exceptional opportunity to acquire a substantial and characterful Victorian terraced townhouse, beautifully presented and occupying a sought-after position within the ever-popular Castletown area of Penrith. Conveniently located for the town centre, excellent transport links, Greystoke and the Lake District National Park, the property combines period charm with modern family living.

Extensively upgraded and thoughtfully improved by the current owners, this impressive home offers versatile accommodation arranged over three floors. An entrance vestibule leads into a superb open-plan living and dining room, centred around a wood-burning stove and flowing seamlessly into a recently fitted, high-specification kitchen. Beyond lies a dedicated preparation area, utility room and cloakroom/WC. To the rear, a hallway with return staircase gives access to a cosy snug featuring exposed brickwork, which in turn opens into a solid-roof conservatory, creating additional year-round living space.

The first floor provides three well-proportioned double bedrooms, including a generous principal suite with en-suite shower room, together with a stylishly refitted four-piece family bathroom.

The second floor offers two further double bedrooms and a useful eaves storage room, making the property ideally suited to larger families or those requiring home-working space.

Outside, the enclosed walled rear garden provides a private and attractive outdoor setting, complete with pedestrian access and a pergola-covered seating area.

Offering generous proportions, flexible accommodation and a superb blend of period features and contemporary improvements, this is a wonderful family home for which early viewing is strongly recommended.

Directions From Penrith town centre, follow Castlegate, crossing the first roundabout. At the next roundabout take the first exit signposted Greystoke. Follow the road around the left and right hand bends, then fork right, onto Howard Street. At the T junction at the end of Howard Street turn right, onto Alexandra Road. At the end of Alexandra Road, turn onto Mill Street, number 11 is on the left.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
